opening_approach: Introduce two synthetic examples of how field observations depend on measurement methods.

segments.editorial_angle: Explain the narrow observation before discussing its significance.
segments.why_it_matters: It shows how directly auditable evidence supports a bounded conclusion.
segments.host_dynamic: Maya establishes the observation and Daniel tests its limitations.
segments.transition_intent: Move from the observation to the method used to interpret measurements.

segments.editorial_angle: Connect calibration frequency to confidence in comparisons.
segments.why_it_matters: Method changes can alter how later observations should be interpreted.
segments.host_dynamic: Daniel leads the method explanation and Maya restates the practical consequence.
segments.transition_intent: Close by linking careful sourcing and careful measurement.

closing_takeaway: Good summaries preserve both what was observed and how it was measured.
